prompt: Create a dependency-free Python 3 CLI at tools/minidiff.py that word-level diffs two text files given as argv[1] and argv[2]. It must print only the changed hunks (unified style, with 1 line of context) and exit 1 if any differences exist, 0 otherwise. Next: create fixtures a.txt (5 lines of prose about a lighthouse) and b.txt (same prose with exactly 3 single-word substitutions), run the tool on them, and confirm the output contains all 3 substituted words. If the tool misbehaves, debug and fix it until the run is clean. End with a final message containing the exact diff output between the two fixtures.
